sanjay: Heads-up: our /v1/embeddings endpoint contract got stricter in schema PR #402 — CI showed failures in prod integration tests. Can we confirm expected behaviour for nullable fields and Content-Type for streaming responses? @rachael @david

rachael: Saw the CI flakes. The PR removed nullable from `metadata` in the response schema. Some clients (mobile SDK) still send `null` for metadata. Do we need to preserve that for backward compatibility?

david: We should accept both `null` and `{}` for at least one release. Making it non-nullable will break older clients. Prefer schema that documents both and server-side normalisation.

kevin: Also flag: streaming path sometimes ends up with `text/plain` from the proxy on final chunk (edge case with gzip + chunking). Contract should guarantee final response is `application/json` for the non-streaming (or final assembled) payload.

contract-bot: contract-bot: CI: test failure on master — /v1/embeddings response schema (metadata) mismatch. Failing job: https://ci.redwood/402/runner/12

rachael: Proposed change: make schema for metadata explicitly allow object OR null. Example JSON Schema snippet:```json
"metadata": {
  "description": "optional freeform metadata; historical clients sometimes send null",
  "anyOf": [ { "type": "object" }, { "type": "null" } ]
}
```Also add a note in the OpenAPI doc and an example response showing `metadata: null` and `metadata: {}`.

sanjay: Good. Can we also add a compatibility test in the contract suite that validates both shapes and asserts `Content-Type: application/json` on final non-streaming responses?

david: I'll add unit + integration tests: one that loads the schema and validates responses with \"metadata\": null and \"metadata\": {}; another that spins up proxy and asserts Content-Type on final chunk. Will open PR and ping for review.

kevin: I'll implement a small proxy fix to force `Content-Type: application/json` on the final assembled response (edge-case detection when upstream sends `text/event-stream`). Will push a patch in ~30m.

rachael: Action items recap:
- david: add tests + PR (compat tests)
- kevin: proxy header fix PR
- sanjay: update OpenAPI comment and add example responses
I'll land the schema change with `anyOf` and a short compatibility note. :thumbsup:

sanjay: Thanks — @contract-bot, please re-run the contract suite after these PRs land and post back here with the job link.

kevin: quick question — should server-side normalisation convert `null` -> `{}` before emitting to clients? That would make downstream simpler.

rachael: Prefer to normalise to `{}` for new clients but keep schema permissive. Logically: accept null, normalize to empty object in the runtime when serving JSON to SDKs. Update changelog.

sanjay: Sounds good. I'll file a tiny RFC note in the repo describing the compat window and deprecation plan.

contract-bot: contract-bot: queued re-run after PRs merge. Will report status.
